note: 星宿关系自查表 — SOURCE OF TRUTH for the star-relationship layer. `order` and `byDistance` are transcribed VERBATIM from the user-provided 星宿关系自查表①②③ and are the only relation mapping. The rest of this file structures that mapping into a 3-dimensional, DIRECTIONAL compatibility model (family × role × distance tier); the scores are this app's resonance interpretation, used only as a supporting 15% modifier — they never override the mapping.
directionConvention: DIRECTIONAL, role-sensitive. fwd = (playerPos - userPos) mod 27 over `order`. fwd==0 -> 命之星 (user=命, player=星). Otherwise the family+tier come from the folded distance k=min(fwd,27-fwd) via byDistance/categoryMeta (the table). The ROLE split within a pair is set by direction: if the player sits FORWARD of the user (fwd in 1..13) the user takes the FIRST role of the pair (荣/友/安/危/业) and the player the SECOND (亲/衰/坏/成/胎); if BACKWARD (14..26) the roles swap. Reading it from the player's side is the reciprocal and yields the same global assignment.

星.sense: the other IS your destined star

荣.sense: the ACTIVE side that elevates / activates / improves the other

亲.sense: the APPROACHABLE side — easy to connect with, naturally felt / lifted

危.sense: the PRESSURING side — high-contrast, stimulating tension

成.sense: the ENABLING side — completing, making results land

业.sense: the BINDING side — karmic task, entanglement

胎.sense: the GESTATING side — latent, slow-forming attachment

友.sense: the PEER side — friendly, supportive, easy to stay in touch with

衰.sense: the WEAKENED side — softer, less reinforced, lower force
